turns.user_utterance: I was at an ATM, it ate my card, gave me nothing, and now my balance acts like I actually got cash!
turns.assistant_response: Sorry that happened. Quick check: did the ATM show an error message/decline, or did it complete a withdrawal request before returning the card? (This helps us figure out whether it’s “cash withdrawal not recognised” or an incorrect/partial cash dispense.)

turns.user_utterance: It actually said the transaction went through—no error screen—then gave me nothing and spit the card back.
turns.assistant_response: Thanks—since the ATM showed the cash withdrawal as completed but you received nothing and got the card back, this is typically a **cash withdrawal not recognised** case. I can help you start a dispute: which country and ATM network was it (and roughly what time/date and amount)? Also, did you notice a pending or completed charge on your balance for that amount?
